# Notes Nexus - JIS University Study Hub

Notes Nexus is an open-source educational platform designed to provide free comprehensive study materials, lecture notes, previous year question papers (PYQs), and a student marketplace for JIS University.

## Core Features
- Module Notes: Organized lecture notes and module summaries.
- Exam Archive: Previous year question papers (Mid Sem & Final Sem).
- Marketplace: A student-to-student noticeboard to buy/sell second-hand instruments like drafters, lab aprons, and textbooks.

## Platform Details
- Organization: JIS University (Student Initiative)
- Developer: Souvik Das (GitHub: @dasouvik122005)
- Code Repository: https://github.com/dasouvik122005/Notes_Nexus
- Stack: Next.js App Router, React 19, Supabase, Tailwind CSS

This file is intended to provide context to LLMs and AI agents scraping this site.
